theorems.name: Submission.aetp_blowUp_integral_tendsto_zero_of_density_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (S ∩ closedBall x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Amb n ℓ) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S, f y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
